education.studyType: Bachelor of Engineering in Robotics Systems Engineering
Diploma in Mechatronics & Robotics, and Diploma Plus in Business

work.name: Ceredroid AI
highlights: Developed autonomous manipulation and perception systems on the Kuavo humanoid and Unitree Go2 quadruped, spanning VLM-based task planning and evaluation, visual servoing, and vision-guided hardware payloads.
Collected teleoperated demonstrations on the Kuavo humanoid for NVIDIA GR00T VLA training, and deployed the trained policies on the robot.

Developed my capstone project in collaboration with the company: a Plan-Act-Correct-Verify (PACV) pipeline for long-horizon humanoid manipulation, using VLMs (Gemini Robotics ER 1.5, Cosmos-Reason1) as planners over NVIDIA GR00T N1/N1.5.
Maintained and upgraded humanoid hardware (Kuavo, Unitree H1): replaced faulty motors, ran firmware updates and recalibration procedures, and authored maintenance SOPs adopted by the team.
Delivered interactive robotics demonstrations at SIT Open House, RoboSG, and community outreach events.

work.name: SIT-FireFense
highlights: Built an object detection pipeline for autonomous grasping on an Omron TM5-700 manipulator, generating 3D pick targets from an Intel RealSense D435i depth camera.
Experimented with and integrated two detection backends into the pipeline, GPT-4o and a YOLO model.
Developed a Python driver for the Robotiq 2F-85 gripper via MODBUS protocol for the TM5-700.

work.name: Singapore Institute of Technology
highlights: Provided technical support for robotics lab operations: soldering, wire crimping, lathe maintenance, and preparing materials and resources for robotics modules.
Performed equipment repair and maintenance on lab tools and robotic chassis used in coursework.

work.name: Singapore Armed Forces
highlights: Managed logistical operations, maintaining operational readiness and support.
Awarded Best Soldier of the Month (BSOM), Sergeant Major Coin, and SBW CO Letter of Commendation.

work.name: Advanced Remanufacturing and Technology Centre (ARTC)
highlights: Optimised mirror-finish polishing on stainless steel using the ABB IRB 140: experimented with spindle speeds, tool paths, and abrasive grits; analysed and documented surface roughness and visual quality.
Integrated the ABB Simplified Robot Programming (SRP) system with the ABB IRB 6660; designed 3D-printed spray nozzle adapters and demonstrated motion tracking at the 2019 ROS-I APAC conference.
Developed components for a new cable management system on the ABB IRB 6660 robot arm, reducing cable strain and preventing entanglement.

projects.name: Capstone: Hierarchical Long-Horizon Planning for Humanoid Robotics
projects.summary: Gemini Robotics ER 1.5, Cosmos-Reason1-7B, NVIDIA GR00T, Python
highlights: Developed a long-horizon planning pipeline that decomposes natural language goals into subtasks, dispatches them to a VLA-driven humanoid, visually verifies each step, and recovers from failures; deployed on the Kuavo V4 Pro.

Iterated from a stateless pipeline to a multi-turn conversation architecture for persistent dialogue context, and constrained VLM-generated plans to the trained skill primitives of the robot to prevent hallucinated dispatch.

Designed a comparative evaluation study across 10,800 scored planning trials with Bonferroni-corrected two-proportion z-tests; Gemini ER 1.5 reached 97.2% success against 40.8% for Cosmos-Reason1 on the confirmatory holdout.

Evaluated long-horizon monitoring on 50 BEHAVIOR-1K household tasks in simulation: near-perfect decomposition (6.68/7), moderate progress monitoring (2.01/3), with object hallucination the dominant failure mode.

projects.name: Storeman-Rosman: Autonomous Dual-Arm Shelf Picking
highlights: Implemented an autonomous dual-arm pick-and-place system on the Kuavo humanoid, with each arm independently fulfilling concurrent customer orders from a shared shelf.
Defined function-call interfaces between the vision module and motion pipeline, dispatching trajectories from object detections through visual-servoing.

Collected and annotated a canned-drink dataset across body and wrist camera views to fine-tune a YOLO detector, and hardened the system with collision-avoidance trajectories and hard-limit safety callbacks.

projects.name: Tic-Tac-Toe Humanoid Demo at RoboSG
projects.summary: Kuavo, ROS, Computer Vision, SolidWorks, Python
highlights: Built an end-to-end demo in which the Kuavo played tic-tac-toe against the public, using a three-stage ROS pipeline (camera alignment, board classification, piece placement) with state management, command queuing, and blocking logic to prevent race conditions.

projects.name: Autonomous Bird-Deterrence System
projects.summary: Unitree Go2, Intel RealSense, YOLO, Arduino, SolidWorks, Python
highlights: Designed and built a vision-guided laser deterrence payload for the Unitree Go2 quadruped, including the electrical schematic for the system, integrating a YOLO model with RealSense depth sensing.
Implemented PID-based target tracking that converts detections and depth measurements into pan-tilt angles, with multiple laser movement patterns to prevent bird habituation.

projects.name: Go2 Public Outreach Quadruped
projects.summary: Android, MQTT, Jetson AGX Orin, SolidWorks, REST
highlights: Developed an Android teleoperation app for Unitree Go2 integrating MQTT communication and the Unitree SportClient SDK; designed mounting hardware for the Jetson AGX Orin, speakers, and portable power to complete the deployable platform.

projects.name: VLM/LLM Evaluation for Robotics
highlights: Evaluated Cosmos-Reason1 and Gemini Robotics ER 1.5 on synthetically generated abnormal-trajectory videos, comparing rule-based against temporal-description prompting strategies and documenting detection failure cases.
Evaluated the K2-Think model via 4-bit quantization, measuring inference latency and VRAM consumption to establish deployment envelopes.

projects.name: EASY Pastry Printer
projects.summary: STM32, C, SolidWorks, Pixy Camera, SCRUM, Project Management
highlights: Collaborated with Nicher, an artisan bakery, to develop a food printer capable of printing 2D images and logos onto a tray of pastries in any orientation autonomously.

projects.name: Bolloré Logistics Modular Assembly Line
projects.summary: ROS1, ROS2, UR10, AgileX-LIMO, Visual Components, STM32, C, Python, SolidWorks
highlights: Collaborated with 3PL company Bolloré Logistics to produce a business case for a modular automated solution that allows for easy integration with emerging technologies for Value Added Service assembly lines.
Simulated the solution in Visual Components and ROS 2 (Gazebo, RViz), then built and integrated a physical proof-of-concept of the assembly line (robotic platform and robotic arm).
Business case projected a 25% increase in throughput and a corresponding 25% reduction in costs and labour, with a projected ROI period of three years.

projects.name: Robotic Platforms
projects.summary: C, Python, Spin Language, STM32, Pixy Camera, Parallax MCU, AgileX-LIMO
highlights: Developed a robotic platform capable of remote control via a GUI, further evolving it into an autonomous system using a Pixy camera to follow coloured objects.
Implemented a Breadth-First Search algorithm in ROS 2 Gazebo and RViz to explore an unknown maze.

Developed scripts for autonomous goal-to-goal navigation, incorporating MoveBaseAction and MoveBaseGoal packages, implemented a GUI with PyQt, and added functionality to save and load robot positions. Optimised navigation behaviour via ROS parameter YAML files.
